description: The General Court session number a vote took place in
The number that a roll call vote took place within the same session. Increments from 0
The given name of a bill that is being vote on in this voting instance
The unique member code associated with the representative casting the current vote
A bit that represents whether the current voter is the presiding authority of the voting branch (i.e. President of the Senate)
The raw vote value for a given voting instance. Valid values include Y N X and P
The full name string of a voting represntative. Includes first and last name along with any additional names
The senate district a representative is elected to represent
The political party a given representitive is affiliated with
The branch of government a representative serves in. In this dataset it always equals Senate
A string of the presiding officer for a given vote. Used for calculating whether a representative voted in line with the presiding officer of a voting instance (tracking unanimity with caucuses)
The raw vote value on a given voting instance. May not match the vote_value for this current voter but is used for comparison metrics. Same valid values as vote_value
The calendar year a voting instance takes place in

A string with yes or no values that indicates where a member is currently still serving in the Senate. Used for aggregating voting trends for members who are currently active (including past votes for still active representatives)
